accepted_changes: shank radius increased moderately to match the observed band
stone diameter reduced from the initial seed and then fitted across front/top views
stone depth and vertical position were adjusted
prongs were constrained to jewellery-specific thickness and changed from cylinders to inward-tapered frustums

visual_findings.front: Strong improvement in band width and central head scale; prong-tip masks remain coarser than the visible metal.
visual_findings.side: Hoop aligns well; basket top and shoulder transition remain simplified.
visual_findings.top: Best exported-CAD fit; band and stone scale are stable, while prong tips remain approximate.
visual_findings.angled: Weakest view. One shoulder is over-projected and the opposite lower silhouette is under-projected, indicating remaining camera and asymmetric-geometry error.
visual_findings.back: Hoop alignment is strong; basket and prong identity remain simplified.

conclusion: The refinement loop works and improved the coherent CAD without topology regression. The next loop should target oblique camera fitting, asymmetric shoulders, basket/gallery geometry, and human-corrected prong boundaries. Dimensional accuracy is still unvalidated without a known measurement.
